title: Hyperbolic dynamics and thermodynamic formalism
summary: Pressure, variational principles, equilibrium states and Bowen's uniqueness criterion for maps and flows on compact spaces; hyperbolic sets, invariant manifolds and local product structure; Bowen's theorem, the Bowen-Ruelle theorem, Bowen-Margulis measures and the SRB theorem for hyperbolic attractors of flows generated by C^2 vector fields (Lebesgue-almost every point of the basin is generic), in particular for transitive C^2 Anosov flows.

layers.title: Bowen balls, topological entropy and the dynamical hypotheses

targets.name: Dynamics.bowenBall
targets.statement: For a map T of a pseudometric space, d_n(x,y) = max_{0<=k<n} d(T^k x, T^k y) (0 for n = 0) and, for eps > 0, B_n(x,eps) is the open d_n-ball; for a flow g and real t >= 0, d_t(x,y) = sup_{0<=s<=t} d(g^s x, g^s y) (so d_0 = d) and B_t(x,eps) is the open d_t-ball.
hypotheses: T : X -> X, or g : Flow R X

locator.where: lines 163-164 (map separation, k in [0,n]) and lines 99-101 (closed flow balls); ClimenhagaThompson2016 lines 175-177

api.name: bowenBall_eq_ball_dynEntourage
api.statement: For eps > 0, B_n(x,eps) is the ball at x of Dynamics.dynEntourage T {d < eps} n; at eps = 0 the metric ball is empty while the entourage ball at n = 0 is univ.

api.name: bowenBall_zero
api.statement: For eps > 0, the map ball B_0(x,eps) = univ and B_1(x,eps) = ball x eps; the flow ball B_0(x,eps) is ball x eps.

api.name: bowenBall_antitone
api.statement: B_{n+1}(x,eps) is contained in B_n(x,eps); the balls increase with eps.

api.name: mapsTo_bowenBall
api.statement: T maps B_{n+1}(x,eps) into B_n(Tx,eps); a semiconjugacy h, Lipschitz with a constant L > 0, maps B^S_n(x,eps) into B^T_n(hx, L eps).

api.name: flow_bowenBall_comparison
api.statement: For t > 0, n >= 1 on a compact metric space, B_{nt}(x,eps) is contained in the g^t-ball B_n(x,eps), and the g^t-ball B_n(x,delta) is contained in B_{nt}(x,eps) when d(y,z) < delta implies d(g^s y, g^s z) < eps for s in [0,t]; the second containment fails at n = 0.

api.name: gammaSet_isClosed
api.statement: For a homeomorphism and eps > 0, Gamma_eps(x) = {y : d(T^k x, T^k y) <= eps for all k in Z} is the intersection over n >= 0 of T^n(closed B_{2n+1}(T^{-n} x, eps)), whose window is [-n, n]; it is closed, and compact when X is compact.

tests.name: rotation_ball
tests.statement: For a rotation of R/Z, B_n(x,eps) is the eps-ball for every n >= 1.

tests.name: doubling_ball
tests.statement: For the doubling map and eps = 1/8, B_n(0,1/8) is the arc of half-width 2^(-n-2): 1/8 at n = 1, 1/16 at n = 2.

tests.name: ball_zero_univ
tests.statement: At n = 0 the Bowen ball is the whole space, matching coverMincard at time zero equal to 1 on a nonempty set.

tests.name: gamma_window
tests.statement: Two-shift, y with its only 1 at coordinate -1: d(T^k 0, T^k y) = 2^(-k-1) for k >= 0 but d(T^-1 0, T^-1 y) = 1, so y is not in Gamma_{1/2}(0); T(closed B_3(T^-1 0,1/2)) excludes y, while T^-n(closed B_{2n+1}(T^n 0,1/2)) tests times n..3n and contains y.

tests.name: gamma_rationals
tests.statement: Identity of Q: Gamma_1(0) = [-1,1] cap Q is closed and not compact; for the identity of R, [-1,1] is compact and is no counterexample.

tests.name: constant_map_radius
tests.statement: Constant map of a two-point space, L = 0, n = 1, eps = 1: the image point is not in the empty ball B_1(pt,0) but is in B_1(pt,1).

tests.name: flow_ball_n_zero
tests.statement: Unit-speed rotation of R/Z, t = 1, eps = 1/4: the time-one ball B_0(x,delta) is the circle, the flow ball B_0(x,1/4) is an arc; the converse containment needs n >= 1.

targets.name: Dynamics.openCoverEntropy
targets.statement: h_cov(T) is the supremum over finite open covers U of lim (1/n) log N(U^n), U^n the join of T^{-k}U over k < n and N the least subcover cardinality; for a nonempty compact Hausdorff space with its uniformity, h_cov(T) = Dynamics.coverEntropy T univ.

api.name: openCoverEntropy_eq_coverEntropy
api.statement: On a nonempty compact Hausdorff space h_cov(T) equals Dynamics.coverEntropy T univ.

api.name: card_join_le
api.statement: N((U v V)^n) <= N(U^n) N(V^n); refining the cover increases the rate; a cover by V-small sets with V inside an entourage W has N(U^n) >= netMaxcard T univ W n, so h_cov is the limit along covers whose members become V-small for every entourage V.

api.name: openCoverEntropy_conj
api.statement: h_cov is a conjugacy invariant and does not increase under factors.

tests.name: identity_zero
tests.statement: The identity has N(U^n) = N(U), so h_cov = 0.

tests.name: full_shift_logk
tests.statement: The full shift on k symbols with the cylinder cover has N(U^n) = k^n, entropy log k.

tests.name: single_cover_nonexample
tests.statement: The trivial cover {X} gives 0 for the full shift; the supremum over covers is required.

targets.name: Dynamics.coverEntropy_iterate
targets.statement: coverEntropy (T^[k]) univ = k * coverEntropy T univ for k >= 1 and uniformly continuous T; for a homeomorphism of a compact Hausdorff space, coverEntropy T.symm univ = coverEntropy T univ.

locator.where: Proposition 4(i), lines 115-123; Walters1982 Chapter 7 for inverses

tests.name: shift_square
tests.statement: The full shift squared has entropy 2 log k.

tests.name: k_zero_empty
tests.statement: k = 0 is excluded: on the empty space the left side is bottom while 0 * bottom = 0; for k >= 1 both sides are bottom.

tests.name: cat_inverse
tests.statement: The cat automorphism and its inverse both have entropy log((3+sqrt5)/2).

tests.name: discrete_integers_identity
tests.statement: For the identity of Z with the discrete uniformity, covers by balls of the diagonal entourage are infinite, so its entropy is infinity while 0 * h(id) = 0; the identity has entropy 0 only on nonempty totally bounded (e.g. nonempty compact) spaces.

targets.name: Flow.topEntropy
targets.statement: h_top(g) = coverEntropy (g 1) univ; on a nonempty compact Hausdorff space coverEntropy (g t) univ = |t| h_top(g) for all real t (0 * oo = 0; on the empty space both sides are bot for t != 0 only), and on a compact metric space h_top(g) is the flow separated-set growth rate (separated = pairwise disjoint open d_T-balls).
hypotheses: X nonempty compact Hausdorff uniform (compact metric for the separated form)

api.name: topEntropy_time
api.statement: On a nonempty compact Hausdorff space coverEntropy (g t) univ = |t| h_top(g) for every real t, with 0 * oo = 0.

api.name: topEntropy_reverse
api.statement: The reversed flow has the same entropy.

api.name: topEntropy_separated
api.statement: On a compact metric space h_top(g) = lim_eps limsup_T (1/T) log of the maximal (T,eps)-separated cardinality.

tests.name: periodic_orbit_zero
tests.statement: The flow on a periodic orbit has entropy 0.

tests.name: suspension_log2
tests.statement: The constant-roof suspension of the full two-shift has h_top = log 2 and h(g^2) = 2 log 2.

tests.name: sampling_nonexample
tests.statement: Sampling the flow at times kT/n for fixed n does not give the flow entropy per unit time.

targets.name: Dynamics.IsExpansive
targets.statement: A homeomorphism T of a metric space is expansive with constant c > 0 if distinct x, y have some n in Z with d(T^n x, T^n y) > c.

api.name: isExpansive_iff_gamma
api.statement: Expansive with constant c iff Gamma_c(x) = {x} for all x.

api.name: isExpansive_uniform
api.statement: On a compact space, for every eps there is N with d(x,y) < eps whenever d(T^n x,T^n y) <= c for |n| <= N (BowenPeriodicPoints1971 Lemma 2.4).

api.name: isExpansive_iterate
api.statement: Expansivity passes to T^{-1} and to T^k, k != 0, and is metric-independent on compact spaces.

api.name: coverEntropy_eq_scale
api.statement: T is entropy-expansive at scale eps when coverEntropy T (Phi_eps x) = 0 for all x (two-sided Gamma_eps for homeomorphisms of compact spaces, BowenEntropyExpansive1972 Corollary 2.3). An entropy-expansive map of a compact metric space has finite entropy, equal to coverEntropyEntourage T univ {d <= eps} (BowenEntropyExpansive1972 Theorem 2.4), finite by Mathlib Dynamics.coverEntropyEntourage_finite_of_isCompact_invariant. An expansive homeomorphism is entropy-expansive at every eps < c, so h_top(T) < oo equals the entropy at any {d <= eps}, eps < c, and there are finitely many points of each period.

tests.name: full_shift_expansive
tests.statement: The full shift with d = 2^(-N) is expansive with c = 1/2.

tests.name: rotation_not_expansive
tests.statement: An irrational rotation is not expansive.

tests.name: finite_identity
tests.statement: The identity of a finite set is expansive; the identity of [0,1] is not.

tests.name: identity_interval_entropy_expansive
tests.statement: The identity of [0,1] is entropy-expansive at every scale but not expansive: finiteness of entropy holds for the wider class, finiteness of periodic points needs expansivity.

targets.name: Flow.IsExpansive
targets.statement: A continuous flow is Bowen-Walters expansive if for every eta > 0 there is eps > 0 such that d(g^t x, g^{s(t)} y) <= eps for all t, for a continuous s with s(0) = 0, implies y = g^u x with |u| <= eta.

locator.where: definition of expansive flow; ClimenhagaThompson2016 lines 359-362

api.name: gamma_subset_orbitSegment
api.statement: Gamma_eps(x) is contained in g^{[-eta,eta]} x (ClimenhagaThompson2016 lines 356-366).

api.name: fixedPoints_isolated
api.statement: Fixed points of an expansive flow are isolated.

api.name: timeMap_entropyExpansive
api.statement: Every time-t map is entropy-expansive (BowenEntropyExpansive1972 Example 1.6); hence on a compact metric space h_top(g) = coverEntropy (g 1) univ < oo by 1.5's finiteness theorem applied to g^1, and every h(g^t) is finite by 1.4.

api.name: topEntropy_lt_top
api.statement: A Bowen-Walters expansive flow on a compact metric space has finite topological entropy.

api.name: isExpansive_reverse
api.statement: Preserved by reversal and rescaling.

tests.name: periodic_orbit_expansive
tests.statement: The flow on a periodic orbit is expansive.

tests.name: linear_irrational_not
tests.statement: The irrational linear flow on the 2-torus is not expansive.

tests.name: identity_flow
tests.statement: The identity flow of the circle is not expansive; of a finite set it is.

targets.name: Dynamics.IsTopologicallyMixing
targets.statement: A map is topologically mixing if for nonempty open U, V there is N with T^n U meeting V for all n >= N; a flow if there is t0 with g^t U meeting V for t >= t0.
hypotheses: T continuous, or g a flow

api.name: mixing_transitive
api.statement: Mixing implies transitivity in forward time: AddAction.IsTopologicallyTransitive for the N-flow Flow.fromIter of a map or homeomorphism and for the nonnegative-time flow Flow.restrictNonneg of a flow; hence also the weaker signed-time predicate for the Z- or R-flow.

api.name: mixing_iterate
api.statement: A homeomorphism is mixing iff some (every) power is mixing.

api.name: flow_mixing_iff_time
api.statement: A flow is mixing iff one (every) time-t map, t > 0, is mixing.

tests.name: full_shift_mixing
tests.statement: The full shift is mixing.

tests.name: rotation_not_mixing
tests.statement: An irrational rotation and the swap of two points are transitive and not mixing.

tests.name: suspension_not_mixing
tests.statement: The constant-roof suspension of a homeomorphism of a nonempty compact metric space is not mixing; on the empty space it is mixing vacuously.

targets.name: Dynamics.HasWeakSpecification
targets.statement: Weak specification: for every delta > 0 there is tau such that any finite family of orbit segments is delta-shadowed by one orbit with gluing times at most tau (maps and flows).
hypotheses: T homeomorphism, or g continuous flow

api.name: strong_imp_weak
api.statement: Strong specification implies weak specification.

api.name: weak_imp_transitive
api.statement: Weak specification of a nonempty system implies transitivity in forward time (exists n >= 0, resp. t >= 0, with T^n U meeting V); the monotone shift, transitive only in signed time, has no weak specification.

api.name: weakSpec_conj
api.statement: Invariant under topological conjugacy of compact systems.

api.name: tail_spec
api.statement: For flows, tail specification at all scales gives the tail property used by ClimenhagaThompson2016 Lemma 2.10.

tests.name: swap_weak_not_strong
tests.statement: The swap of two points has weak specification with tau = 1 but no strong specification.

tests.name: full_shift_strong
tests.statement: The full shift has strong specification with gap about 2m at scale 2^(-m).

tests.name: disjoint_union_nonexample
tests.statement: A disjoint union of two full shifts has no weak specification.

targets.name: Dynamics.HasBowenProperty
targets.statement: phi has the Bowen property for T if there are eps > 0 and K with |S_n phi(x) - S_n phi(y)| <= K for y in B_n(x,eps); for a flow with orbit integrals over [0,t] and y in B_t(x,eps).

api.name: bowen_vectorSpace
api.statement: Bowen potentials form a vector space containing the constants; smaller scales keep K.

api.name: coboundary_bowen
api.statement: psi o T - psi is Bowen with K = 4 sup|psi|.

api.name: flowCoboundary_bowen
api.statement: L_g psi is Bowen with K = 4 sup|psi| for psi differentiable along the flow with continuous derivative.

tests.name: constant_bowen
tests.statement: A constant potential is Bowen with K = 0.

tests.name: coordinate_bowen
tests.statement: On the full two-shift x -> x_0 is Bowen at eps = 1/2 with K = 0.

tests.name: harmonic_nonexample
tests.statement: phi(x) = 1/m (m least index >= 1 with x_m = 1) is continuous but not Bowen: harmonic sums diverge.

targets.name: Dynamics.pressure
targets.statement: Z_n(phi,U) = sup over finite (n,U)-separated sets s of sum_{x in s} exp(S_n phi(x)); P_T(phi) = sup over entourages U of expGrowthSup (n -> Z_n(phi,U)) in EReal.

locator.where: lines 88-102, equations (1)-(3); Walters1982 Section 9.1; BowenRuelle1975 lines 161-173

api.name: pressure_zero
api.statement: P_T(0) = Dynamics.coverEntropy T univ.

api.name: pressure_metric
api.statement: On a metric space P_T(phi) = lim_eps limsup (1/n) log Z_n(phi,eps).

api.name: pressure_basis
api.statement: The supremum may be taken along a basis of the uniformity.

api.name: pressure_empty
api.statement: P = bottom on the empty space; P >= inf phi on a nonempty space.

tests.name: point_pressure
tests.statement: On a one-point space P(phi) = phi(pt).

tests.name: finite_identity_max
tests.statement: For the identity of an m-point space P(phi) = max phi.

tests.name: shift_constant
tests.statement: For the full shift on k symbols P(c) = log k + c.

targets.name: Dynamics.pressure_eq_spanning_eq_openCover
targets.statement: On a nonempty compact Hausdorff space with continuous T and phi, P_T(phi) equals the spanning-set pressure and the limit of the open-cover pressure p(T,phi,U) = lim (1/n) log inf over subcovers of U^n of sum_A sup_A exp(S_n phi) as U becomes fine: for every eps there is an entourage V with |p(T,phi,U) - P_T(phi)| <= eps for every finite open cover by V-small sets (and p >= a for every real a when P = oo); precisely growth(Z_n(phi,W)) <= p(T,phi,U) <= P_T(phi) + osc_V(phi) for V-small U and W containing V. The supremum over all covers is not the pressure.

tests.name: zero_potential
tests.statement: For phi = 0 the three forms are the entropies of 1.2; refining never lowers p(T,0,U).

tests.name: finite_identity
tests.statement: For the identity of an m-point discrete space all forms give max phi; the cover by points has p_n = sum_x e^{n phi(x)}.

tests.name: inf_nonexample
tests.statement: At the coarse cover {X} of a two-point identity sup gives max phi and inf gives min phi; along fine covers both converge to P = max phi.

tests.name: coarse_cover_nonexample
tests.statement: Fixed point p (phi = 2) disjoint from the two-shift (phi = 0): P = 2; the cover {p} cup {x_0 = i} has p_n = 2^n e^{2n}, rate 2 + log 2 ~ 2.693; the fine cover {p}, {x_0 = 0}, {x_0 = 1} gives e^{2n} + 2^n and rate 2.

targets.name: Dynamics.pressure_properties
targets.statement: For continuous T on a nonempty compact Hausdorff space: P(0) = h_top; h_top + min phi <= P(phi) <= h_top + max phi; monotone; P(phi + c) = P(phi) + c; 1-Lipschitz and convex when h_top < oo; P(phi + psi o T - psi) = P(phi); P_{T^k}(S_k phi) = k P_T(phi); conjugacy invariance.

locator.where: Theorem 9.7 (first four items), Theorem 9.8 (power rule and conjugacy invariance); BowenRuelle1975 line 174

tests.name: lipschitz_sharp
tests.statement: P(c) - P(0) = c on the full two-shift.

tests.name: coboundary_shift
tests.statement: Adding x_1 - x_0 to 0 on the full two-shift keeps P = log 2.

tests.name: power_rule
tests.statement: On the full two-shift with phi = x_0, the square has pressure 2 log(1+e).

targets.name: Flow.pressure
targets.statement: P_g(F) = lim_eps limsup_T (1/T) log Z_T(F,eps), Z_T the sup over (T,eps)-separated sets of sum exp of orbit integrals; theorem: P_g(F) = P_{g^1}(F_1), P_{g^t}(F_t) = t P_g(F) for t > 0, P_g(0) = h_top(g).

api.name: flowPressure_add_const
api.statement: P_g(F + c) = P_g(F) + c; monotone, 1-Lipschitz, convex when h_top finite.

api.name: flowPressure_coboundary
api.statement: P_g(F + L_g psi) = P_g(F).

api.name: flowPressure_reverse
api.statement: The reversed flow has the same pressure; independence of the metric.

tests.name: constant_potential
tests.statement: P_g(c) = h_top(g) + c.

tests.name: periodic_orbit_average
tests.statement: On a periodic orbit of period p, P_g(F) is the orbit average.

tests.name: rescaling_nonexample
tests.statement: For g'(t) = g(2t), P_{g'}(2F) = 2P_g(F) while using F gives 2P_g(F/2).

targets.name: Dynamics.invariantMeasures
targets.statement: M(T) = probability measures preserved by T; M(g) = probability measures preserved by every g^t; flow ergodicity is ErgodicVAdd R X mu for Flow.toAddAction.
hypotheses: T measurable for the definition, convexity and extreme points
T continuous on a nonempty compact Hausdorff Borel space for existence
T continuous on a compact metric Borel space for compactness

api.name: invariantMeasures_convex
api.statement: For measurable T, M(T) is convex and its extreme points are the ergodic measures; for continuous T on a nonempty compact Hausdorff Borel space it contains a regular member; on the empty space it is empty.

api.name: invariantMeasures_compact
api.statement: For continuous T on a compact metric space with its Borel sigma-algebra, M(T) is compact in ProbabilityMeasure X, being the fixed-point set of the weakly continuous pushforward by T.

api.name: flowInvariant_average
api.statement: M(g) = mu in M(g^1) invariant under g^s for s in [0,1]; averaging sends M(g^1) into M(g).

api.name: flowErgodic_extreme
api.statement: Flow-ergodic measures are the extreme points of M(g).

tests.name: swap_unique
tests.statement: For the swap of two points M(T) = {(delta_a + delta_b)/2}.

tests.name: rotation_haar
tests.statement: For an irrational rotation M(T) = {Haar}.

tests.name: periodic_flow_nonexample
tests.statement: For a periodic orbit of period p, M(g) is one measure while M(g^p) contains all point masses of the orbit.

tests.name: discontinuous_not_closed
tests.statement: On X = {0} u {1/n}, T(0) = 1, T(1/n) = 1/n: each delta_(1/n) is invariant and tends to delta_0, but T_* delta_0 = delta_1, so M(T) is not closed.

tests.name: discontinuous_or_empty_no_measure
tests.statement: On the same X, T(0) = 1, T(1/n) = 1/(n+1) forces every point mass to 0, so M(T) is empty; on the empty space there is no probability measure.

targets.name: Dynamics.measureEntropy_mix
targets.statement: For finite partitions P, Q: h_mu(T,P) <= h_mu(T,Q) + H_mu(P|Q), from the finite-label chain rule (ProbabilisticAndMetricNumberTheory 5.1a) applied to n-fold joins (H(P^n) <= H(Q^n) + sum_{i<n} H(T^{-i}P | T^{-i}Q) = H(Q^n) + n H(P|Q)) with the decrease of conditional entropy under enlargement of the conditioning sigma-algebra (ArithmeticDynamics 2.7) and invariance of mu; h_{p mu + (1-p) nu}(T) = p h_mu(T) + (1-p) h_nu(T) for mu, nu in M(T); and h_mu(T, xi) >= integral of h_{mu_x}(T, xi) for a measurable family with integral mu.

tests.name: two_point_identity
tests.statement: Mixtures for the identity of two points have entropy 0 though partition entropy log 2 at n = 1.

tests.name: bernoulli_mixture
tests.statement: Mixture of Bernoulli(1/2) and Bernoulli(1/3,2/3) has entropy about 0.6648, less than 0.6792 for Bernoulli(5/12,7/12).

tests.name: trivial_weights
tests.statement: p = 0, 1 or nu = mu give the trivial identity.

tests.name: conditional_inequality_shift
tests.statement: Bernoulli(1/2) on the two-shift: P = x_0 partition, Q trivial gives log 2 <= 0 + log 2 (equality); P = (x_0,x_1), Q = x_0 gives log 2 <= log 2 + log 2 with H(P|Q) = log 2, and without the conditional term the inequality log 2 <= 0 would be false.

tests.name: fair_bit_conditioning
tests.statement: A fair bit has label entropy log 2, conditional entropy log 2 given the trivial label and 0 given itself: refinement of the conditioning decreases conditional entropy.

targets.name: Dynamics.measureEntropy_eq_lim_fine
targets.statement: For continuous T on a compact metric space and mu in M(T): h_mu(T, xi_k) -> h_mu(T) when diam xi_k -> 0; h_mu(T) is the sup over finite partitions with null boundaries; refining by iterates does not change the rate.

tests.name: bernoulli_fine
tests.statement: Coordinate partitions on [-k,k] give rate log 2 for Bernoulli(1/2).

tests.name: identity_zero
tests.statement: For the identity every rate is 0.

tests.name: trivial_partition
tests.statement: The trivial partition has rate 0; diameters must tend to 0.

targets.name: Dynamics.IsExpansive.upperSemicontinuous_measureEntropy
targets.statement: For an expansive homeomorphism with constant c of a compact metric space, h_mu(T) = h_mu(T, xi) for every mu in M(T) and partition of diameter < c, and mu -> h_mu(T) is upper semicontinuous on M(T) and bounded by h_top < oo.
hypotheses: T expansive homeomorphism with constant c

locator.where: Theorem 8.2; ClimenhagaThompson2016 Theorem 3.2, lines 504-509; BowenEntropyExpansive1972 Theorem 3.5, lines 297-299

tests.name: shift_generator
tests.statement: On the full two-shift the partition by x_{-1},x_0,x_1 (diameter 1/4) has rate H(p) for Bernoulli(p).

tests.name: periodic_measures
tests.statement: The uniform probabilities on Fix(T^n) of the two-shift (entropy 0) converge to Bernoulli(1/2) (entropy log 2): every length-m cylinder gets mass 2^-m once n >= m; not lower semicontinuous. The orbit measures of (10^(n-1))^Z converge to the point mass at 0^Z instead.

tests.name: identity_interval
tests.statement: The identity of [0,1] is not expansive but all entropies vanish.

targets.name: Flow.IsExpansive.upperSemicontinuous_measureEntropy
targets.statement: For a Bowen-Walters expansive flow on a compact metric space there is eps > 0 with h_mu(g^1) = h_mu(g^1, xi) for mu in M(g^1) and d_1-diameter of xi < eps; mu -> h_mu(g^1) is upper semicontinuous on M(g).

locator.where: Theorem 3.2 and Propositions 3.3-3.4, lines 504-535; BowenEntropyExpansive1972 Example 1.6

tests.name: periodic_orbit
tests.statement: For a periodic orbit M(g) is one measure of entropy 0.

tests.name: suspension_log2
tests.statement: The product measure on the suspension of the two-shift has h(g^1) = log 2.

tests.name: irrational_linear
tests.statement: The irrational linear flow is not expansive; all entropies are 0.

targets.name: Flow.measureEntropy_timeMap
targets.statement: For a continuous flow on a compact metric space and mu in M(g), h_mu(g^t) = |t| h_mu(g^1) for all real t (0 * oo = 0).

api.name: flowEntropy
api.statement: h_mu(g) := h_mu(g^1).

tests.name: roof_two
tests.statement: Constant roof 2 over Bernoulli(1/2): h(g^2) = log 2, h(g^1) = (log 2)/2.

tests.name: periodic_orbit
tests.statement: Every time-t map of a periodic orbit flow has entropy 0.

tests.name: negative_time
tests.statement: h(g^{-1}) = h(g^1); without |t| the formula would give negative entropy.

targets.name: Dynamics.measureEntropy_add_integral_le_pressure
targets.statement: For continuous T on a nonempty compact Hausdorff uniform space, continuous phi and regular mu in M(T): h_mu(T) + integral phi <= P_T(phi).

tests.name: bernoulli_bound
tests.statement: H(p) <= log 2 with equality only at p = 1/2.

tests.name: two_point
